verdict.rationale: SavvyCal ships a documented REST API, OAuth/personal-access-token auth, webhooks, and a JS embed library, showing genuine API-based access to core scheduling functions, but there is no evidence the API covers the full breadth of UI features (round-robin, meeting polls, workflows, Stripe payment links, custom branding) and probes for an OpenAPI spec/llms.txt both 404, suggesting incomplete or undocumented API surface parity. missing for 10: evidence that advanced UI features (round robin, polls, workflows, payments, branding) are fully exposed via API, a public OpenAPI/schema reference, and independent confirmation of parity.
